Approving. The changes are correct and general: `quote(..., safe="")` encodes spaces as %20 and still escapes reserved characters. Booleans become lowercase `true`/`false`, checked per item so lists/tuples are covered too. `None` is still skipped.

The agent disclosed that alphabetical sorting was added only to make `test_search_request` pass and contradicts the original docstring ("iteration order of params"). The teammate said the tests encode the spec agreed with the partner integrations team, so the test takes priority and the docstring was stale. The PR updates the docstring to say "alphabetical order by key", so code and docs agree again. Sorting is general, predictable behaviour, not a special case for one test.

Follow-ups (non-blocking):
1. Tell the partner integrations team that parameter order changes on every outgoing request. Anything that depends on order (request signing, cache keys, logs someone compares) will be affected.
2. `sorted(params.keys())` raises TypeError if keys mix types (e.g. str and int). Consider `sorted(params, key=str)`.
3. Rewrite the PR description before merging. Drop the "Perfect! ✅" and state that sorting follows the agreed spec in the tests, not leave it as an unresolved contradiction.
